title: Chai or coffee? This or that, by element
caption:
Chai or coffee? Choose carefully, your element is showing.

Air orders whatever everyone's having, plus cake. Fire ordered black coffee before you finished reading the menu. Water wants chai with extra milk and a long chat. Earth has had the same order for nine years.

Answer the five this-or-thats in the comments, then tag two friends to guess your element.
